trs.203: Until, when he reached the setting place of the sun, he found it setting in a spring of black muddy (or hot) water. And he found near it a people. We (Allâh) said (by inspiration): "O Dhul-Qarnain! Either you punish them, or treat them with kindness."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا

trs.20: He said, "As for one who wrongs,<sup foot_note=196708>1</sup> we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
trs.85: He answered, ‘We shall punish those who have done evil, and when they are returned to their Lord He will punish them [even more] severely,
trs.22: He said: "Whoever doth wrong, him shall we punish; then shall he be sent back to his Lord; and He will punish him with a punishment unheard-of (before).
trs.203: He said: "As for him (a disbeliever in the Oneness of Allâh) who does wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with a terrible torment (Hell).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا

trs.20: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease."
trs.85: while those who believed and did good deeds will have the best of rewards: we shall command them to do what is easy for them.’
trs.22: "But whoever believes, and works righteousness,- he shall have a goodly reward, and easy will be his task as We order it by our Command."
trs.203: "But as for him who believes (in Allâh’s Oneness) and works righteousness, he shall have the best reward, (Paradise), and we (Dhul-Qarnain) shall speak unto him mild words (as instructions)."

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

trs.20: Then he followed a way
trs.85: He travelled on;
trs.22: Then followed he (another) way,
trs.203: Then he followed another way,

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًا

trs.20: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun [i.e., the east], he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
trs.85: then, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it.
trs.22: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no covering protection against the sun.
trs.203: Until, when he came to the rising place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We (Allâh) had provided no shelter against the sun.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا

trs.20: Thus.<sup foot_note=196709>1</sup> And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
trs.85: And so it was: We knew all about him.
trs.22: (He left them) as they were: We completely understood what was before him.
trs.203: So (it was)! And We knew all about him (Dhul-Qarnain).

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

trs.20: Then he followed a way.
trs.85: He travelled on;
trs.22: Then followed he (another) way,
trs.203: Then he followed (another) way,

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا

trs.20: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
trs.85: then, when he reached a place between two mountain barriers, he found beside them a people who could barely understand him.
trs.22: Until, when he reached (a tract) between two mountains, he found, beneath them, a people who scarcely understood a word.
trs.203: Until, when he reached between two mountains, he found, before (near) them (those two mountains), a people who scarcely understood a word.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا

trs.20: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog<sup foot_note=196710>1</sup> are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
trs.85: They said, ‘Dhu ’l-Qarnayn, Gog and Magog are ruining this land. Will you build a barrier between them and us if we pay you a tribute?’
trs.22: They said: "O Zul-qarnain! the Gog and Magog (People) do great mischief on earth: shall we then render thee tribute in order that thou mightest erect a barrier between us and them?
trs.203: They said: "O Dhul-Qarnain! Verily Ya’jûj and Ma’jûj (Gog and Magog)<sup foot_note=154693>1</sup> are doing great mischief in the land. Shall we then pay you a tribute in order that you might erect a barrier between us and them?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا

trs.20: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam.
trs.85: He answered, ‘The power my Lord has given me is better than any tribute, but if you lend me your strength, I will put up a fortification between you and them:
trs.22: He said: "(The power) in which my Lord has established me is better (than tribute): Help me therefore with strength (and labour): I will erect a strong barrier between you and them:
trs.203: He said: "That (wealth, authority and power) in which my Lord had established me is better (than your tribute). So help me with strength (of men), I will erect between you and them a barrier.

verses.text_uthmani: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا

trs.20: Bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
trs.85: bring me lumps of iron!’ and then, when he had filled the gap between the two mountainsides [he said], ‘Work your bellows!’ and then, when he had made it glow like fire, he said, ‘Bring me molten metal to pour over it!’
trs.22: "Bring me blocks of iron." At length, when he had filled up the space between the two steep mountain-sides, He said, "Blow (with your bellows)" Then, when he had made it (red) as fire, he said: "Bring me, that I may pour over it, molten lead."
trs.203: "Give me pieces (blocks) of iron;" then, when he had filled up the gap between the two mountain-cliffs, he said: "Blow;" then when he had made them (red as) fire, he said: "Bring me molten copper to pour over them."

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسْطَـٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًا

trs.20: So they [i.e., Gog and Magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
trs.85: Their enemies could not scale the barrier, nor could they pierce it,
trs.22: Thus were they made powerless to scale it or to dig through it.
trs.203: So they [Ya’jûj and Ma’jûj (Gog and Magog)] could not scale it or dig through it.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّا

trs.20: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord<sup foot_note=196711>1</sup> comes [i.e., approaches], He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
trs.85: and he said, ‘This is a mercy from my Lord. But when my Lord’s promise is fulfilled, He will raze this barrier to the ground: my Lord’s promise always comes true.’
trs.22: He said: "This is a mercy from my Lord: But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will make it into dust; and the promise of my Lord is true."
trs.203: (Dhul-Qarnain) said: "This is a mercy from my Lord, but when the Promise of my Lord comes, He shall level it down to the ground. And the Promise of my Lord is ever true."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ جَمْعًا

trs.20: And We will leave them that day<sup foot_note=196712>1</sup> surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
trs.85: On that Day, We shall let them surge against each other like waves and then the Trumpet will be blown and We shall gather them all together.
trs.22: On that day We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another: the trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them all together.
trs.203: And on that Day [i.e. the Day Ya’jûj and Ma’jûj (Gog and Magog) will come out], We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another; and the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them (the creatures) all together.

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا

trs.20: And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display -
trs.85: We shall show Hell to the disbelievers,
trs.22: And We shall present Hell that day for Unbelievers to see, all spread out,-
trs.203: And on that Day We shall present Hell to the disbelievers, plain to view -

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا

trs.20: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance,<sup foot_note=196714>1</sup> and they were not able to hear.<sup foot_note=196713>2</sup>
trs.85: those whose eyes were blind to My signs, those who were unable to hear.
trs.22: (Unbelievers) whose eyes had been under a veil from remembrance of Me, and who had been unable even to hear.
trs.203: (To) those whose eyes had been under a covering from My Reminder (this Qur’ân), and who could not bear to hear (it).

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًا

trs.20: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
trs.85: Did they think that they could take My servants as masters instead of Me? We have prepared Hell as the disbelievers’ resting place.
trs.22: Do the Unbelievers think that they can take My servants as protectors besides Me? Verily We have prepared Hell for the Unbelievers for (their) entertainment.
trs.203: Do then those who disbelieved think that they can take My slaves [i.e., the angels, Allâh’s Messengers, ‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)] as Auliyâ’ (lords, gods, protectors) besides Me? Verily, We have prepared Hell as an entertainment for the disbelievers (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)<sup foot_note=154694>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَـٰلًا

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Shall we tell you who has the most to lose by their actions,
trs.22: Say: "Shall we tell you of those who lose most in respect of their deeds?-
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Shall We tell you the greatest losers in respect of (their) deeds?

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا

trs.20: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
trs.85: whose efforts in this world are misguided, even when they think they are doing good work?
trs.22: "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their works?"
trs.203: "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life while they thought that they were acquiring good by their deeds.<sup foot_note=154695>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَزْنًا

trs.20: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight [i.e., importance].
trs.85: It is those who disbelieve in their Lord’s messages and deny that they will meet Him.’ Their deeds come to nothing: on the Day of Resurrection We shall give them no weight.
trs.22: They are those who deny the Signs of their Lord and the fact of their having to meet Him (in the Hereafter): vain will be their works, nor shall We, on the Day of Judgment, give them any weight.
trs.203: "They are those who deny the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord and the Meeting with Him (in the Hereafter). So their works are in vain, and on the Day of Resurrection, We shall assign no weight for them.

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا

trs.20: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
trs.85: Their recompense for having disbelieved and made fun of My messages and My messengers will be Hell.
trs.22: That is their reward, Hell, because they rejected Faith, and took My Signs and My Messengers by way of jest.
trs.203: "That shall be their recompense, Hell; because they disbelieved and took My Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and My Messengers by way of jest and mockery.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا

trs.20: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise<sup foot_note=196715>1</sup> as a lodging,
trs.85: But those who believe and do good deeds will be given the Gardens of Paradise.
trs.22: As to those who believe and work righteous deeds, they have, for their entertainment, the Gardens of Paradise,
trs.203: "Verily those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, shall have the Gardens of Al-Firdaus (Paradise) for their entertainment.

verses.text_uthmani: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا

trs.20: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
trs.85: There they will remain, never wishing to leave.
trs.22: Wherein they shall dwell (for aye): no change will they wish for from them.
trs.203: "Wherein they shall dwell (forever). No desire will they have for removal therefrom."

verses.text_uthmani: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَـٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًا

trs.20: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words<sup foot_note=196716>1</sup> of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it in [continual] supplement."
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘If the whole ocean were ink for writing the words of my Lord, it would run dry before those words were exhausted’- even if We were to add another ocean to it.
trs.22: Say: "If the ocean were ink (wherewith to write out) the words of my Lord, sooner would the ocean be exhausted than would the words of my Lord, even if we added another ocean like it, for its aid."
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to mankind): "If the sea were ink for (writing) the Words of my Lord, surely, the sea would be exhausted before the Words of my Lord would be finished, even if We brought (another sea) like it for its aid."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا

trs.20: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
trs.85: Say, ‘I am only a human being, like you, to whom it has been revealed that your God is One. Anyone who fears to meet his Lord should do good deeds and give no one a share in the worship due to his Lord.
trs.22: Say: "I am but a man like yourselves, (but) the inspiration has come to me, that your Allah is one Allah: whoever expects to meet his Lord, let him work righteousness, and, in the worship of his Lord, admit no one as partner.
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I am only a man like you. It has been revealed to me that your Ilâh (God) is One Ilâh (God - i.e. Allâh). So whoever hopes for the Meeting<sup foot_note=154696>1</sup> with his Lord, let him work righteousness and associate none as a partner in the worship of his Lord."
